property_summary: For any fuzzed input, a successful transferOwnership must leave owner() equal to the requested non-zero address; ownership may never become address(0). The mutant drops the zero-address requirement, so a transfer to address(0) succeeds and leaves owner() == address(0), breaking the rule.
change_summary: Remove the zero-address requirement so ownership can be transferred to address(0), changing the resulting owner() value.
